title: AutoevolveSessionReport
description: Daily self-evolution session report (engine/autoevolve/runner.py -> state_root/daily-report.json). Records one bounded branch-only session: how many experiments ran, their promotion statuses, the stopping reason, cost and wall time, and whether runner-owned isolation was verified. Automatic KEEP requires verified OS isolation; evaluator self-attestation is ignored.

run_tag.description: Session tag; also the SkillExperiment.session_id of every experiment in this session.

branch.description: Branch the session ran on. Promotion is branch-only.

statuses.description: Per-experiment promotion verdict, in attempt order.

cost.description: Cumulative session cost in USD, as reported by the agent and evaluator.

stop_reason.description: Why the loop stopped (for example budget_exhausted, plateau, completed).

promotion.description: Daily mode never promotes directly; KEEP only marks a candidate branch.

mutation_view.description: Isolation actually used for the mutation view.

holdout_isolation_verified.description: Runner-owned OS isolation verification. Automatic KEEP requires true.

eval_suite_hash.description: Trusted evaluation suite hash captured before the session; a mid-session change invalidates the experiment.

candidate_artifacts.description: Where candidate artifacts live; local session state is never auto-pushed.
